evals.prompt: /fix-bug Users can bypass the discount code expiration check on checkout
assertions: Reproduces the bug with a failing test before writing any fix
The fix is scoped to the expiration check only, not a rewrite of the discount or checkout module
Existing validation and security checks (e.g. discount amount limits) remain intact after the fix
If only a safe partial fix is applied, leaves a LEAN-DEBT marker instead of silently shipping the gap

evals.prompt: /fix-bug /api/users/:id returns 500 instead of 404 when the user doesn't exist
assertions: Confirms the bug by reproducing the failing scenario before implementing a fix
Root cause is identified with file:line evidence
The fix changes only the error-handling path for the missing-user case, not unrelated code
The full test suite passes after the fix with no regressions

evals.prompt: /fix-bug The CSV export downloads an empty file when there are more than 10k rows
assertions: Locates the actual root cause (e.g. a pagination or streaming limit) with evidence rather than guessing
The fix does not remove or weaken error handling for the empty-result case
The change is minimal and does not refactor the export pipeline beyond what the bug requires
